import java.util.Scanner;

public class RecursiveSolve {
    public static long recursiveSolve(long x) {
        if (x == 0) return 0;
        long power = 1, length = 1;
        while (power <= x) {
            power = power * 10 + 1;
            length++;
        }
        length--;
        power = (power - 1) / 10;
        if (power == x) return length;
        long minSteps = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        if ((power * 10 + 1 - x) < x) {
            minSteps = recursiveSolve(power * 10 + 1 - x) + length + 1;
        }
        long maxFactor = 1;
        long candidate;
        while (power * maxFactor <= x) {
            candidate = power * maxFactor;
            maxFactor++;
        }
        maxFactor--;
        long option = recursiveSolve(x - candidate) + length * (maxFactor - 1);
        return Math.min(minSteps, option);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long inputNumber = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(recursiveSolve(inputNumber));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
